catholic-encyclopedia-1913-adolphe-perra: This 1913 reference piece on Adolphe Perraud — the French cardinal, Oratorian, and Bishop of Autun. Joseph Lataste sketches his learned life. His pulpit and pen served the Third Republic's Church. A scholar in a red hat. France honored its eloquent prelate.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-antoine-domin: A 1913 entry on Antoine-Dominique Magaud — a French painter of note. Gaston Sortais records his works. The entry preserves his modest fame. His brush served the Paris salons. An artist of the nineteenth century. His portraits hang in the Lyons museum.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-augustus-theb: A 1913 entry on Augustus Thébaud — a Jesuit educator of note. Charles Herbermann records his career. The entry preserves his modest fame.
